paragraphs.text: The Mox Opal is a legendary artifact and mox jewel seen on the planes of Mirrodin / New Phyrexia and Kaladesh .

The Mox Opal was originally seen on Mirrodin / New Phyrexia in the possession of the Mirran Resistance (due to its use of Metalcraft ) where it is said the suns of Mirrodin shone upon perfection only once. Though it eventually fell into the hand of a Phyrexian who admired its perfection to such a degree that defied the Phyrexian Orthodoxy as it caused her to question if perfection existed beyond compleation . It appeared as a colorful opal encased in a metallic medallion. It was also one of the inventions seen at the Inventors' Fair on Kaladesh where it was said to be on loan from a private collection and had a unique mechanism that extracts power from the carefully prepared gemstone.
